metadata.titleDefault: NSTORE — Multi-tenant SaaS CRM for SMBs
metadata.description: NSTORE is a next-generation smart CRM for small and medium-sized businesses. It combines AI-driven sales-funnel analysis, workflow automation for customer follow-up, and strict tenant data isolation.
metadata.ogTitle: NSTORE — Multi-tenant SaaS CRM for SMBs
metadata.ogDescription: A smart CRM that helps grow revenue by 30%, with built-in AI analytics and sales workflow automation.
metadata.keywords: CRM, SaaS CRM, multi-tenant CRM, customer management, sales software, pipeline automation, Sales CRM, smart CRM, AI CRM, NSTORE

hero.title: Next-generation <hl>smart</hl> customer management
hero.subtitle: Accelerate sales for small and medium businesses with a visual Kanban board, isolated multi-tenant security and an AI assistant that analyzes your meeting notes. Automatic data import with AI column mapping and audit logs keep your company's assets safe.
hero.demoAdminDesc: Full admin rights, log access, permission setup.
hero.demoManagerDesc: Manage the team's deals and opportunities.
hero.demoSalesDesc: View/edit only your own data. No log access.

featuresSection.title: Solving every pain point of SME sales teams
featuresSection.subtitle: We streamline your business processes and apply advanced AI automation to help your company outperform.

tenantIsolation.title: Absolute tenant isolation
tenantIsolation.shortDesc: A rigorous multi-tenant architecture that fully isolates data at the database and cache layers, preventing information leaks.
tenantIsolation.detailsDesc: Every company that signs up gets its own workspace with a unique TenantID. Tenant data is encrypted and safely filtered at the Prisma ORM layer before any SQL runs, so cross-organization data leaks can never happen.

kanban.title: Smooth deal Kanban
kanban.shortDesc: Drag deals freely between pipeline stages with instant response powered by dnd-kit.
kanban.detailsDesc: Track and update deal status in the blink of an eye. Smooth drag-and-drop with dnd-kit and instant cache sync with React Query deliver a zero-lag experience.

aiAnalysis.title: AI analysis & suggestions
aiAnalysis.shortDesc: Deep OpenAI GPT-4o-mini & Groq Llama3 integration to parse raw meeting notes, suggest tasks and draft follow-up emails.
aiAnalysis.detailsDesc: Break down meeting minutes or a raw transcript in seconds. The AI automatically builds a list of concrete tasks with due dates and drafts a deal-specific follow-up email for you.
aiAnalysis.demoItem1: 1. Send the Enterprise quote by Thursday (Due: 07/12)
aiAnalysis.demoItem2: 2. Call to confirm the number of users at 9 AM
aiAnalysis.demoEmail: Hi Alex, here's the draft contract for 12 users on the Enterprise plan…

excelImport.title: AI Excel Import
excelImport.shortDesc: Upload an Excel file to bulk-import customer data. The AI recognizes and maps column headers automatically and accurately.
excelImport.detailsTitle: Automatic data import with AI Match
excelImport.detailsDesc: Free yourself from manual data entry by uploading a raw Excel file. AI automatically detects, maps and matches custom columns (e.g. 'Phone no.', 'Mailbox') to the corresponding standard fields in the CRM.

rbac.title: Dynamic RBAC & ABAC
rbac.shortDesc: Dynamic role-based permissions (RBAC) combined with ownership-attribute access control (ABAC) for maximum security.
rbac.detailsDesc: A perfect blend of flexible role-based permissions (RBAC) via a visual permission matrix and fine-grained access control by resource-ownership attributes (ABAC). All rules are cached in Redis for instant API response.

auditLogs.title: Audit logs
auditLogs.shortDesc: Automatically records every create, edit and delete on deals and contacts, with before/after values. More transparency.
auditLogs.detailsTitle: A system log for fraud monitoring
auditLogs.detailsDesc: Protect your organization's data by automatically logging every update or deletion of deals and contacts. Admins and Managers can compare old and new values to quickly restore mistaken changes.

aiDemo.title: An AI-powered automation engine
aiDemo.subtitle: We provide breakthrough AI tools that remove the most tedious manual steps in customer management. Pick an AI feature below and try it out:

notes.step0: Click Run call analysis demo to see the AI extract information from a sales rep's raw notes.
notes.typing: NSTORE AI is auto-typing the raw text…
notes.transcript: Call with Alex from NovaTech at 10 AM. He wants to upgrade to the Enterprise plan for 12 users, quoted a discounted 15M/month. This deal looks very promising — he'll send the contract next Monday for signing and payment.
notes.action1: Draft & send the Enterprise contract (12 users, 15M/month)
notes.action2: Follow up with the customer to sign the contract and pay next Monday
notes.draftSubject: Subject: NSTORE – Enterprise upgrade proposal & draft contract
notes.draftBody: Hi Alex, thanks for taking the time to talk. I've attached the draft Enterprise contract for 12 users at a special 15M/month for your review…

excel.step0: Click Run Excel AI Match demo to see the AI analyze custom column headers from a customer's raw Excel file.
excel.mapping: The AI assistant is mapping automatically…
excel.footer: Clicking "Confirm import" triggers dedupe logic, assigns an owner and saves to the DB automatically.

rolesMatrix.abacNote: The 🔒 icon stands for ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control): the system automatically injects a safe filter into the SQL via Prisma so a user can only act on records they directly own.
rolesMatrix.title: Dynamic role management & row-level security
rolesMatrix.subtitle: Keep your organization's information as safe as possible. The system moves you from traditional static roles to flexible dynamic permissions managed through a visual matrix interface.
rolesMatrix.bullet1: Custom roles: easily add new roles (e.g. Contributor, Tech Support) with fine-grained permissions.
rolesMatrix.bullet2: Smart data filtering (ABAC): sales reps only see and work with their own customers, preventing cross-leakage of opportunities.
rolesMatrix.bullet3: Instant speed with Redis: user permissions are cached so permission checks on API calls never slow things down.

auditSection.title: Activity monitoring & change history (audit logs)
auditSection.subtitle: Every change to sensitive data (deals, contacts) is tracked automatically, helping you stay in control and prevent loss of company assets.
auditSection.whyTitle: Why does a business need an activity log?
auditSection.whyText: In a fast-moving sales team, customer data and deals change constantly. Audit logs help managers see exactly what happened and protect the company's digital assets.
auditSection.benefit1Text: Every create, deal-value update or contact deletion is recorded instantly by the backend and cannot be altered or removed.
auditSection.benefit2Text: Beyond the action itself, the system stores the diff for each field so mistakes are easy to roll back.
auditSection.benefit3Text: Only admin roles like ADMIN and MANAGER can view the workspace-wide audit logs, protecting employee privacy.
